title: A Dream within a Dream
description: Trapped in a fictional realm, Xiaoyu finds herself forced into the narrative as a persecuted heroine, subject to the cruelty of the male protagonist Nanheng. She resists but is bound by the storyline's predetermined path.

title: A Man Without a Shadow
description: A movie maker experiences in real life the similar events he made a movie about.

title: A Whale of a Tale
description: The camera delves into the lives of local whalers, global activists and an American journalist in the "whale and dolphin killing town" of Taiji, Japan, revealing not everything is as black and white as it seems.

title: A Hick a Slick and a Chick
description: A mouse named Elmo, who's a bit of a yokel, goes to beautiful Daisy Lou to woo her. However, he finds her with the slick Blackie.

title: A Name Without a Place
description: While retracing his late-brother's footsteps through the Florida Keys, a sheltered young man stumbles upon the secret estate of a narcissistic recluse.

title: A God Without a Universe
description: After years in prison, Anders reunites with his sister Mia. However, their traumatic past haunts them both. Anders falls back into his old habits, while Mia discovers a sinister side of herself and those around her.

title: A Sense of a Maze
description: In this allegorical documentary we exercise a search for answers to life's unpronounced questions in the labyrinth of a medieval medina. The milestones of the quest are existential, scientific, religious and artistic expressions. Here colors, sounds, figures and authentic musical threads lead the wanderer. The verbal, as well as the visual and sonic guidance concerns eternal truth-seeking, fear, foreignness, the sacredness of life, the discovery of "otherness", the loss of the garden of Eden, inside and outside, work and worship, ecstasy and pacification.

title: Give a Dog a Bone
description: Mickey is tired of living with his lazy dad and shrewish mom. With his faithful dog Ringo, he leaves home to seek fortune in London, but they meet Mr Space from another planet who teach them politeness and reconcile them to their parents.

title: A Witch Without a Broom
description: A witch from the 16th century falls for a modern-day professor and sends him on an adventure in time.

title: A View to a Kill
description: Billionaire Max Zorin is planning to create a series of explosions that will destroy San Andreas and it's up to British secret agent James Bond to stop him.

title: Build a House, Plant a Tree
description: Juraj Jakubisko's first feature film after a forced nine-year-long break is a story about an unconventional man, Jozef Matús. He arrives to a small village in eastern Slovakia to settle down and start a family. He is ready to subordinate everything to his goal. It all starts with stealing building material and ends with him disregarding those close to him to a point where his ambitions are turning against him. Build a House, Plant a Tree is a viewer-friendly film with a plot resembling a western, including several attractive action sequences.

title: A Man, a Woman and a Bank
description: The two least likely bank robbers in the known universe plan and execute... kind of... the ultimate heist.

title: A Rock and a Hard Place
description: Tom is a small-time drifter without a care in the world until he finds himself trapped on a dangerous, remote island and infatuated with Cynthia, a mysterious young married woman who seems part beautiful innocent, part not-so-innocent.

title: A Mom, a Son, and a Dream
description: Join Stacy Adams-Wright and Tarasha Holland as they share the triumphs, challenges, and unwavering support behind Delon, Dorell, and Ron's NBA dreams and achievements.

title: A Girl in a Lower Grade
description: When Tsuyoshi rushed to school as usual, he found a girl who tried to help a kitten which couldn't get down from a tree. It was Minamizato Ai who had loved Tsuyoshi secretly for a long time.

title: A Profetisa
description:
Eis a lenda:
Na Antiguidade, a vidente Elara Valente, para salvar o povo da calamidade, desfez sua própria divindade em doze fragmentos — o Olho Onisciente, que penetrava os desígnios do céu; o Sopro Divino, que desafiava a morte; o Guerreiro Eterno, invencível —, dando origem às doze grandes casas aristocráticas.
Sessenta anos depois, ela retorna. De cabelos brancos até os ombros e com um véu negro sobre os olhos, em sua forma mortal.
O comandante de ferro Xavier Cael é designado para vigiá-la. Mas, passo a passo, torna-se seu principal guarda-costas… e seu mais devoto crente.
Desta vez, ela não vem apenas para recolher os fragmentos.
Vem para reescrever as regras deste mundo.

title: A Little Girl in a Big City
description: Small-town girl Mary Barry wins a beauty contest and goes to New York to meet D. V. Cortelyou, the magazine's publisher. Greatly taken by young girl, Cortelyou arranges for her to live with Dolly Griffith, a woman of questionable reputation who often aids him in his wicked schemes of blackmail and seduction. During a party seemingly in Mary's honor, Cortelyou obtains some apparently compromising evidence with which to blackmail Mrs. Young, the wife of a wealthy broker; Cortelyou then makes rough advances toward Mary, and one of his assistants, Jack McGuire, gives him a good beating. Threatened with blackmail, Mrs. Young turns in desperation to Jack for help. Jack and Mary attempt to trap Cortelyou in a net of his own making, but the blackmailer is too smart, outwitting Jack and abducting Mary. Cortelyou also kidnaps Mrs. Young, keeping her and Mary in a deserted house. Jack learns of their whereabouts and arrives with the police. Cortelyou is arrested, Mrs. Young is saved from the consequences of scandal, and Jack proposes to Mary.

title: My Unique B&B
description: Master carpenter Simon Parfett and his team help families, couples and retirees cash in on untapped, income-generating potential in their unused or underused spaces by creating their own unique B&B.

title: Billionaire B&B
description: Yasmine Akram is on a mission to guide you around the exotic lives of the rich and famous. How will she cope living it up like a billionaire in Ibiza, Mallorca, LA and Barbados where she meets some of the islands wealthiest residents and goes behind the closed doors of some of the most expensive houses? Even if Yasmine can't quite live the dream on an RTE budget, she's more than happy to rent the dream for now as she test drives some of the most stunning airbnb homes / high end rentals on the planet. Each episode is based in a fabulous super rich playground, Ibiza/Mallorca, Los Angeles and Barbados, where there is no shortage of fabulous properties with eye, watering price tags and endless other ways of spending those super rich fortunes. Expect Yaz to overdose on glass palaces, historical chateaux, infinity pools, superyachts, private beaches, million dollar kitchens, all with views to die for.

title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: Plan B
description: When three young martial artists embark on a relentless treasure hunt in order to free their friend from the grasp of a ruthless gangster, they get entangled in a complex conspiracy staged to dethrone Berlin's underworld kingpin.

title: B420
description: Koey believes happiness is like a bottle of coke, it'll soon become tasteless if you don't enjoy it right away. Simon believes happiness is similar to planting trees. You need to water them everyday, and the true satisfaction comes when they blossom. Willy does not believe in happiness at all. Three lives intersect. Three totally different personalities. Three ways of experiencing life and love.

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. title: B&W
description: Swaranjali is a painter with aspirations of becoming one of the world's greatest painters. During this process, she develops a new type of live musical painting in which she paints while dancing to the music. Vardhan is an aspiring music director who works for film industry. Due to lack of opportunities, he was unable to become what he desired, and in his frustration, he became addicted to drugs. Yamini, as a singer, aspires to reach greater heights in the music industry with her singing talent. She hangs out a lot and doesn't take things seriously in the process, all three become good friends, and because Swaranjali and Vardhan love each other, they begin a living relationship, with Swaranjali morally and financially supporting Vardhan. In the process of introducing her live music painting theme to the world, she meets famous event organizer Rakesh, but Rakesh, being a playboy, wants every girl to be around him rather than helping them. As a neighbor, Papua irritates Swaranjali by knowing about her relationship with Vardhan and tries to attract her while she avoids him. Swaranjali planned a surprise party for Vardhan's birthday and invites all for the party. Vardhan was discovered dead in Swaranjali house on the same day.How does Swaranjali get out of this murder mystery and achieve her goal?

title: TAMED
description: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: Love is Sweet
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: Hlidac c.47
description: A WW I veteran still haunted by his time in the trenches settles in a small town to work for the railroad company. His pretty wife attracts the attention of the lonely young gravedigger.

title: The Bar-C Mystery
description: Chapter 5: "Thundering Hoofs." Summary: Nevada and Jane are in the path of a thundering herd of cattle, prodded on by the outlaw gang. Nevada is making a brave effort to save Jane, but his horse stumbles and leaves them at the peril of oncoming cattle.

title: City of Romance [Hindi]
description: Bai Xiao Duo, who hides behind lies due to low self-esteem, meets Su Yan Cheng, a genius cartoonist who despises lies. Despite their differences, they heal each other through a series of events, gradually mending their inner wounds.

title: 96°C Café
description: 96°C Café is set against the backdrop of a homely café, owned by married couple Liqiao (Desmond Tan) and Xijie (Paige Chua). When Xijie meets with an accident, she stops working at the café and things start to change. As Xijie becomes more forlorn and withdrawn, Liqiao over time develops an unlikely affinity with Yuchen (Julie Tan), a fine arts student hired to help out in the café. With an unexpected twist at the end of the mini drama, this is a contemporary love story which brings cheers and tugs at the heartstrings of viewers.

title: When Destiny Brings the Demon
description: A self-proclaimed "slacker" immortal master meets a mortal who changes his outlook on life. As they grow closer, their romance unfolds across three different realms, leading them to fight for both their love and universal peace.

title: Studio C+
description: Join Lisa Clark Valentine as she interviews your favorite cast members, gives a peek behind the scenes, and looks back on fan favorite Studio C moments. Fans interact with the cast through activities like breaking out of an escape room.

title: My Stepbrother by Day, My Forbidden Lover by Night
description: On a first-class flight to her mother’s wedding, broke scholarship student Lily spends one reckless night with Ryder, an irresistible football star. By morning, she plans to forget him—until she arrives at her new home and discovers he is her future stepbrother. Lily vows to stay away to protect her mother’s hard-won happiness, but Ryder refuses to pretend they are family.

title: When C Goes with G7
description: When a heartbroken film school graduate, an unemployed UC Berkeley MBA graduate and a junior high school student converge at the music instruments store of an aspiring musician, quirky thoughts on everything from work and education to love and life emerge against a truly catchy soundtrack. Relationships end and hopes are occasionally dashed in this episodic drama, but few could complain that this isn't a thoughtful attempt to capture the sentiments of growing up in Hong Kong as we know it today.

title: Oops! The Alpha's Bride Is a Boy
description: After an unforgettable night with a mysterious man, Fenrir never expects to see him again—until he discovers the stranger is Lucien, the powerful Alpha of the Lusen Family. When Fenrir's twin sister Chloe elopes, he is forced to take her place in a one-month trial marriage with Lucien. Now he must keep his true identity hidden as their forbidden bond grows and the power buried within him begins to awaken.

title: Tales of Demons and Gods [English] S1-S9
description: In his past life, although too weak to protect his home when it counted, out of grave determination Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. Although he's the weakest in his class with the lowest talent, having only a red soul realm and a weak one at that, with the aid of the vast knowledge which he accumulated from his previous life, he decided to train faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life to train faster as well. He aims to protect the city from the coming future of being devastated by demon beasts and the previous fate of ending up destroyed. He aims to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath. And he aims to destroy the so-called Sacred family who arrogantly abandoned their duty and betrayed the city in his past life.

title: Who Stole My AC in 40°C Heat?
description: Marco, an appliance dealer who rose from the bottom, returned to his old apartment building and paid out of his own pocket to install air conditioners for every household, as a way of repaying the kindness he had received years ago. However, his neighbor Marina took the lead in filing claims under various pretexts and engaging in moral blackmail. Without arguing, Marco dismantled all the air conditioners overnight and took them away. When the scorching heat arrived, the old building suffered terribly, while the new building across the street remained cool and orderly. After enduring heatstroke, shortages, and failed extortion attempts, the neighbors finally broke down and had no choice but to turn to Marco for help. Marco presented them with a business contract and insisted that things be done according to the rules. In the end, the neighbors paid to have the units reinstalled—except for Anna, the only one who had stayed clear-headed back then, and who received Marco's free, special care.

title: Blues Run the Game: The Strange Tale of Jackson C. Frank
description: In the mid-60s, Jackson C. Frank released a masterpiece of folk music in Britain. This young American songwriter was close to Simon & Garfunkel, Bert Jansch, John Renbourn, Al Stewart, Roy Harper, Sandy Denny and many others. All of them were influenced by this enigmatic and tormented character. Shortly after the release of his unique album, he disappeared. Wrecked by a series of tragedies in his life, he chose to cut himself off from the world and got trapped by his demons. Still today, young musicians like John Mayer, Laura Marling or Robin Pecknold perform Blues Run the Game. This documentary follows Jackson C. Frank's footsteps to unknot the threads of a tragic destiny. Facts and songs don't express everything about a man, a personality. Who was Jackson C. Frank? Who remembers him? Where to find meaning, or even light, in a life as dark as his?

title: Murder of Innocence
description: Newlywed Laurie Wade's deeply-rooted psychotic behavior shatters her marriage, and eventually her entire life. She goes from brief "short circuits" to overtly murderous behavior. The film never tries to explain the cause of her mental collapse, except for a hint or two, but instead takes the viewer into her frightening state of mind.

title: Louis C.K. Oh My God
description: In February, 2013, Louis brings his impish nihilism to Phoenix, Arizona. He talks about an old lady and her pet, living in Manhattan, experiencing his body's aging (he's 45), men's fascination with women's breasts, the beauty of living outside the food chain, his quickness to anger while driving, and murder. It's theater in the round, so he's in constant motion, a grin nearly always on his face.

title: CEO's Cute Charm For Love
description: Song Yujia and Lu Huanyu's new drama begins with a special marriage. In the marriage, the man went abroad with a third party, and the two lived based on an agreement not to interfere with each other. The heroine Xu Wenyan chose to support a gigolo in response. Two years later, when her husband, who was married in disguise, returned to China, it foreshadowed the resurgence of this complicated relationship - Xu Wenyan's relationship with the gigolo came to an end. At the same time, the prince of the Beijing circle, who had been silently supporting the heroine, decided not to hide his true feelings and identity anymore, and strived to spend the rest of his life with the heroine as a formal partner, starting a battle for love and identity.

title: No Sword Can Rival Hers
description: At five, she slew a dragon—then hid her sword for thirteen years. Old law: women who wield swords are crippled or killed. Her aunt won a duel disguised as a man; she was broken and jailed for thirteen years. Now her family falls. Vera disguises as Gavin, sweeps the royal trials, and when orcs storm the capital, she kills the Orc King. The old law dies. Girls can wield swords openly—and Vera frees her aunt.

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

description: The Goddess of Wealth, Ann Lowe, is reincarnated as Eva Shaw’s unborn daughter, whom she is carrying in her womb. From within the womb, Ann guides Eva to build a fortune in stocks and shine at auctions. Mother and daughter join forces to defeat her biased father and rise to become the world’s top billionaires.

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

title: Caché Derrière Les Roses ( Doublé )
description: Pour jauger sa fiancée Zoé, le milliardaire Maël se glisse à la fac en se faisant passer pour un étudiant défavorisé. Zoé le désigne comme cobaye d'un jeu. Elle simule une cour assidue, ayant parié avec ses complices qu'elle l'abandonnerait en un mois. Maël entre dans la danse tout en contrôlant chaque mouvement en coulisses, et ceux qui se croyaient prédateurs deviennent des proies. Il transforme la chasse en condamnation publique retentissante de la jeunesse dorée.

title: Forever After, Never Again (DUBBED)
description: Neglected by her father and stepmother since childhood, Elara Rhode hires Ethan Walden as her personal bodyguard—only to fall in love with him and begin pursuing his affection. But Ethan remains distant. Unbeknownst to Elara, he is secretly the heir to the powerful Walden family—and harbors feelings for her stepsister instead. Devastated and furious, Elara impulsively marries Charlie Shaw, a man trapped in a vegetative state.

title: [Doublé] Il ne reste plus toi dans ma vie
description:
Sophie, véritable dirigeante du Groupe Célestia, avait renoncé à son rôle au sommet de l’entreprise afin de soutenir son mari Alex. Elle s’était volontairement retirée pour devenir femme au foyer, et avait consacré sept années entières à prendre soin de sa famille. Elle avait même veillé sur Alex lorsqu’il avait été gravement malade, l’ayant accompagné sans relâche jusqu’à sa guérison, en y mettant toute son énergie et toute sa tendresse.



Cependant, cet amour qu’elle avait donné sans compter s’était transformé en une trahison totale. Le jour même de la cérémonie des cent jours de leur fils Léo, Alex a ramené sa maîtresse Emma ainsi que son fils illégitime Félix. Sous la complaisance de ses parents, Alex a imposé à Sophie un choix injuste : soit accepter la cohabitation avec Emma et Félix et continuer à servir la famille Bernard, soit divorcer sans pouvoir emmener son enfant.

title: Love for You
description: In the 1990s, teens Chen Yi and Miao Jing meet through family, starting off poorly. After personal losses, they grow close. When danger arises, Chen Yi pushes Miao Jing away. Years later, she returns and he vows to protect her.

title: Mecha Underdog
description: Jax Thorne, the legendary 5-time mecha champion, was betrayed and discarded by his club for being "too old." Left penniless, he’s taken in by Amy, the beautiful owner of a failing gym, hiding his identity as a humble mechanic. But when ruthless rivals push Amy to the brink, the King must rise. With his secret SSS-class mecha, Phoenix, Jax is ready to crush his betrayers and claim his queen!

title: Only Tamed for You
description: Joan White, heir to the White Group, was betrayed by her sister and fiancé, left for dead at sea. She survived, but with the mind of a child. Taken in by the mysterious Tommy Frim, they married in a flash. He doted on her, and love quietly bloomed.But after a blow to the head at a party,Joan's memories return. With her past restored, will her revenge begin?

title: Rejected Siren, Chosen by the Prince
description: Voiceless Alicia trusts Rayne, unaware she's a pawn in his revenge. Forced to marry the "Mad Prince" Kane, she's framed and tortured as Rayne watches. Her hidden bloodline awakens. At Rayne's engagement, she exposes the lies, leaving proudly with Kane. Kane isn't mad—just tormented by the sea's cries—and together they heal. Consumed by obsession, Rayne wages war for her but fails. He's imprisoned; Shelly ruined. Voice restored, Alicia guards the deep sea with Kane.

title: Sniper Butterfly
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.
